title: Experience Florida Keys Boat Charter Private Tour
blurb:
Cruise the beautiful waters of the Florida Keys on an authentic tiki bar boat during this 1.5-hour Tiki Fun Cruise. Sip your favorite beverage while soaking in the sun and taking in stunning views of luxurious homes and coastal landscapes. Keep your eyes peeled for dolphins, sea turtles, and tropical seabirds as you glide over the crystal-clear waters. You can choose between a scenic harbor cruise or an island swim stop at a sandy beach for a refreshing dip in the turquoise sea. This is the perfect way to create unforgettable memories in paradise.

- Enjoy a leisurely 1.5-hour cruise on a tiki bar boat
- Spot local wildlife, including dolphins and sea turtles
- Customize your cruise with a scenic harbor tour or beach swim
- Knowledgeable Captain shares local history and fun facts
